text:
maria (devex): quick note — customer rotated a staging API key and their sample-app started throwing 401s. CLI login fixed token but project header disappeared. curious if we have a policy for persisting project across refresh.

aj (sdk): can you paste repro? minimal steps please.

maria (devex): 1) set REDWOOD_API_KEY + REDWOOD_PROJECT=tenant-x 2) run sample-app 3) rotate key in portal 4) app 401s after ~20-40s 5) rwd login succeeds but session.json lacks project so subsequent calls drop x-rwd-project.

leo (cli): confirmed. CLI writes token+org to ~/.redwood/session.json but not project. when login refreshes we overwrite session without project.

samir (platform): short-term: persist a small client_metadata blob (project + default headers) with session tokens. long-term: consider embedding project as a JWT claim.

aj (sdk): I'll add Session.metadata to SDKs and make refresh reapply headers. will add unit that simulates rotation and asserts header preserved.

leo (cli): will add --project flag to rwd login and write project into session.metadata. prefer CLI flag > REDWOOD_PROJECT env > session metadata.

jen (support): I'll update KB with precedence order and include `rwd login --show-session` sample.

auth-bot: rotation detected for key pk_77 at 2091212150. tokens invalidated 2091212160 -> 2091212180.

maria (devex): action items: aj (SDK patch, ETA 48h), leo (CLI session metadata + migration, ETA 24h), samir (backend follow-up). thanks.

aj (sdk): starting PR, will ping for review.
